children: The Michael Zheng option in Polymarket's US Open ATP submarket for Michael Zheng vs. Arthur Gea rose sharply to 58.5% from 38.5% one hour earlier, a 20 percentage point increase. According to ChainCatcher, Catcher Predict monitoring said the move reflected a sudden swing in the prediction market and noted that related breaking news may have influenced the change.

title: Polymarket Michael Zheng Option Jumps to 58.5% in US Open ATP Market
